_comment: MANIFEST-style expected-reachability fixture for the corpus additions under testdata/python/ and testdata/java/ (see docs/REACHABILITY.md). Consumed by tests/golden/test_reachability_corpus.py.

python.scenario: hashes.SHA512() inside a helper called from a @app.route-decorated function
hashes.SHA3_256() inside a helper called from an ordinary (non-entry-point) function
ElGamal.generate() inside a helper whose only caller is a test file
ChaCha20.new() inside a helper reachable only via an unresolved dynamic-dispatch table lookup
hashes.SHA512() in level_2(), reached via main -> root_entry -> dispatch -> level_2 in a 6-level deep call chain; level_2 directly calls level_4 (RSA)
rsa.generate_private_key() in level_4(), called directly by level_2 (SHA-512) and directly calling level_6_leaf (MD5) in a 6-level deep call chain
hashes.MD5() in level_6_leaf(), called directly by level_4 (RSA), the deepest node in a 6-level deep call chain

java.scenario: MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-512") inside a helper called from a @RestController public method
MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA3-256") inside a helper called from an ordinary (non-entry-point) method
Signature.getInstance("SHA256withDSA") inside a method whose only caller is a *Test.java file
Cipher.getInstance("DES") inside a method reachable only via an unresolved Map<String, Runnable> dispatch

c.scenario: SHA512_Init() inside a helper called directly from main(), C's tagged entry point
EVP_sha3_256() inside a helper called from an ordinary (non-main) function
SHA384_Init() inside a helper whose only caller is testdata/c/tests/test_reachability_inert.c
EVP_sha3_512() inside a helper reachable only via an unresolved function-pointer table lookup (dispatch_table[idx]())

RSA_sign() in sign_leaf(), reached via main -> sign_entry -> sign_middle -> sign_leaf in a 3-hop call chain; sign_leaf's 256-byte signature buffer also fires a Pillar-3 blast-radius finding, so this fixture also intersects the blast-radius shockwave view with real call-graph data
